lastSession.summary: M1 Deterministic Traffic Core completed. Built constants/time, directed road graph, seeded OD demand, deterministic router, vehicle state machine, environment-enforced signal safety, queue/wait/throughput metrics, and the production TrafficEngine; Canvas now renders real engine state. All 8 M1 exit criteria met with tests; 30-minute Fixed golden baseline saved and locked. npm run check passes (83 tests + build). M1 -> done, M2 -> active (MaxPressure remains unimplemented).

M2.2: implement lane pressure computation (upstream demand minus downstream capacity) with hand fixtures; do not tune signals yet.

Record any reward/decision-semantics choice in docs/DECISIONS.md before coding it (D-006 common-random-numbers still applies).
